title: Linked Lists
subtitle: Treat a list as a graph of node identities: preserve reachability while you rewire one boundary at a time.
variables: n,m = reachable node counts; k = group size or number of lists; h = heap size <= k; N = total nodes across lists. Unless stated otherwise lists are finite, acyclic, singly linked, values compare in O(1), and nodes use identity equality/hash. Auxiliary space excludes existing nodes and returned newly allocated nodes; recursion frames count. Pointer access/rewiring is O(1), locating a node is O(n). Python arbitrary-size arithmetic and comparison can add bit-length costs; hash bounds are expected. Mutation may affect every alias to a node; no concurrent mutation. Operation table costs describe the named operation on preexisting state; executable examples also construct small fixtures and verify results, whose setup/assertion cost is not the operation cost.

templateDetails.preconditions: Finite acyclic singly linked list; rewires existing nodes, returns new head or None. Node identities and payloads preserved.
templateDetails.observation: Reconstruct invariant: prev is reversed processed prefix; cur begins untouched suffix. Adaptation: Read-only callers need a cloned chain first.

templateDetails.preconditions: Acyclic chain, integer n; 1-based from end. Returns retained head, bypasses target, does not clear its next. Invalid n raises before mutation.
templateDetails.observation: Reconstruct invariant: prev.next is next candidate and all retained nodes before prev are valid. Adaptation: Filter all targets; sorted run removal may bypass a whole run.

templateDetails.preconditions: Disjoint finite sorted nondecreasing chains with comparable values; consumes/rewires inputs, left-before-right ties, reuses nodes. Both empty -> None.
templateDetails.observation: Reconstruct invariant: Output prefix is sorted and contains exactly consumed input nodes. Adaptation: Nonmutating merge allocates new output nodes.

templateDetails.preconditions: Singly linked successor graph; returns entry object or None, no mutation, arbitrary repeated values allowed. n counts distinct reachable nodes.
templateDetails.observation: Reconstruct invariant: At meeting the distance relation makes head-to-entry equal a whole-cycle-adjusted meeting-to-entry. Adaptation: Detection only stops at meeting; entry requires second phase.

templateDetails.preconditions: Finite acyclic chains, possibly shared suffix; returns first shared identity or None; never mutates. Not valid for cyclic lists.
templateDetails.observation: Reconstruct invariant: Both pointers traverse equal total combined lengths before meeting or None. Adaptation: Cyclic intersections need case analysis; this template is acyclic only.

templateDetails.preconditions: Acyclic chain, 1-based integer inclusive bounds, 1<=left<=right<=length. Rewires nodes and returns head; invalid bounds raise before mutation; empty input has no valid nonempty range.
templateDetails.observation: Reconstruct invariant: Reversed segment prefix is attached to predecessor; segment tail retains untouched suffix. Adaptation: Validate first to guarantee no partial mutation on bad bounds.

templateDetails.preconditions: Acyclic list, integer k>0; reuses/relinks nodes, leaves incomplete final group unchanged, empty returns None.
templateDetails.observation: Reconstruct invariant: Finished prefix is grouped correctly and connects to untouched remaining suffix. Adaptation: k=1 leaves order; reject nonpositive k.

templateDetails.preconditions: Finite acyclic list, payloads comparable with pivot; rewires stable <pivot then >=pivot partitions, conserves all node identities, empty None.
templateDetails.observation: Reconstruct invariant: Each processed node appears exactly once in its proper stable chain. Adaptation: More than two predicates use a bounded set of dummy/tail pairs.

templateDetails.preconditions: Acyclic chain with non-throwing value equality; temporarily rewires second half but restores exact original links on normal return, even mismatch. Empty True. Not concurrently observable/read-only safe.
templateDetails.observation: Reconstruct invariant: Fast advances twice as far; chosen stop leaves balanced disjoint halves. Adaptation: Second middle for LC876; first-half tail for palindrome/weave.

templateDetails.preconditions: Acyclic chain; mutates links to L0,Ln,L1,Ln-1,... preserving payloads/identities; returns original head, empty None.
templateDetails.observation: Reconstruct invariant: Fast advances twice as far; chosen stop leaves balanced disjoint halves. Adaptation: Second middle for LC876; first-half tail for palindrome/weave.

templateDetails.preconditions: Finite acyclic next chain, random is None or references a node in that chain; RandomNode payloads are scalar/immutable (payload copied by reference). Temporarily mutates next links, restores originals, output nodes/links disjoint; empty None. Assumes allocation succeeds and no concurrent observation.
templateDetails.observation: Reconstruct invariant: After interleaving each original is immediately followed by its clone. Adaptation: External random targets rejected by map version; arbitrary graph policy must be specified.

templateDetails.preconditions: Reusable collection/iterable of pairwise disjoint acyclic nondecreasing chains; comparable values, identity nodes not orderable. Consumes links, returns reused sorted chain, stable within each input but cross-list tie order is insertion-to-heap order. Empty heads -> None.
templateDetails.observation: Reconstruct invariant: Heap contains exactly each nonempty remainder minimum. Adaptation: Divide-and-conquer merges also cost O(N log k); require disjoint input nodes.

templateDetails.preconditions: Finite acyclic digit chains, least significant digit first; None represents zero, both None returns a fresh Node(0). Validates integer digits 0..9 before allocation; no input mutation, allocates output. Bool follows Python int semantics.
templateDetails.observation: Reconstruct invariant: Processed output digits equal low-order sum digits with remaining carry. Adaptation: None represents zero; emit fresh zero node for both empty.

templateDetails.preconditions: Finite acyclic chain; returns original second-middle identity for even length, None empty, no mutation. For first-half tail guard fast.next and fast.next.next instead after checking head.
templateDetails.observation: Reconstruct invariant: Fast advances twice as far; chosen stop leaves balanced disjoint halves. Adaptation: Second middle for LC876; first-half tail for palindrome/weave.

templateDetails.preconditions: Finite acyclic chain. remove_values accepts equality-comparable payloads; other functions require sorted nondecreasing input so equal values form one run. Reuses retained node identities, bypasses removed nodes, returns new head; detached aliases may retain old links. Keep-one and remove-entire-run are different contracts.
templateDetails.observation: Reconstruct invariant: prev.next is next candidate and all retained nodes before prev are valid. Adaptation: Filter all targets; sorted run removal may bypass a whole run.

templateDetails.preconditions: Finite acyclic chain, integer k>=0; rewires identities, returns new head. Normalize before cycle creation; temporary cycle is always broken on normal return. No concurrent observation.
templateDetails.observation: Reconstruct invariant: The final cut leaves each old node reachable exactly once in rotated order. Adaptation: k multiple of n is no-op; reject negatives before mutation.

templateDetails.preconditions: Finite acyclic singly linked list with nonthrowing comparable values; stable ascending sort by relinking, no payload swap or node allocation except one dummy. Empty None. Each pass detaches disjoint runs; width doubles. Inputs consumed/mutated; top-down alternative has O(log n) frames.
templateDetails.observation: Reconstruct invariant: Before each pass all width-sized runs are sorted; after it all 2*width runs are sorted. Adaptation: No array conversion or recursion needed for O(1) auxiliary linked sort.

templateDetails.preconditions: Finite acyclic next chain of identity-hashable nodes; random targets inside chain or None, external target raises ValueError without mutating input. Payload references reused, not recursively deep-copied; all structural output nodes new. Use graph traversal map for cyclic next or arbitrary graph cloning instead.
templateDetails.observation: Reconstruct invariant: After interleaving each original is immediately followed by its clone. Adaptation: External random targets rejected by map version; arbitrary graph policy must be specified.

templateDetails.preconditions: Integer capacity>=0; stable hashable keys, arbitrary values. get changes recency and returns supplied default on miss (not LC-specific -1). put inserts/overwrites and evicts oldest; capacity zero stores none. Owned storage mutates, sentinels never evicted; not thread-safe. Hash collisions may degrade operations to O(capacity), allocation/list edits are O(1).
templateDetails.observation: Reconstruct invariant: Map and list contain the same real nodes exactly once, ordered least-to-most recent. Adaptation: LFU/TTL are different eviction contracts; zero capacity is valid.

decisionProcess: 0–20 seconds: Clarify singly/doubly, acyclic/cyclic, identity versus payload, shared nodes, mutation permission and required output head.
20–45 seconds: Draw empty, singleton and two-node cases. Identify predecessor, changed boundary links and successor that must be saved.
45–80 seconds: Choose dummy for head edits; gap for end-relative position; fast/slow for middle/cycle; reversal for mirrored order; merge for sorted fronts; DLL+map for recency.
80–120 seconds: State reachability/conservation invariant. Split before weave/merge, validate bounds before rewiring, preserve identities unless allocating a copy is part of the contract.

120–180 seconds: Trace repeated values, shared tail, incomplete k-group, final carry and restored links. Give locating versus splicing cost, recursion/output space, stability, and a read-only alternative.

practiceDetails.insight: Reversed prefix plus untouched suffix conserves reachability. Mastery: reconstruct unaided, demonstrate node/link invariant on paper, justify O(n) time; O(1) auxiliary, and expose: Save successor before rewiring.
Stay on predecessor after deletion to remove adjacent targets. Mastery: reconstruct unaided, demonstrate node/link invariant on paper, justify O(n); O(1), and expose: Consecutive matching heads.
Equal values are adjacent only under sorted precondition. Mastery: reconstruct unaided, demonstrate node/link invariant on paper, justify O(n); O(1), and expose: Sorted precondition.
Select smaller front with explicit stable ties. Mastery: reconstruct unaided, demonstrate node/link invariant on paper, justify O(n+m); O(1) auxiliary, and expose: Disjoint inputs; tie stability.
Meet by identity; repeated values do not imply a cycle. Mastery: reconstruct unaided, demonstrate node/link invariant on paper, justify O(n); O(1), and expose: Identity, not value equality.
Even-length LC876 asks for second middle. Mastery: reconstruct unaided, demonstrate node/link invariant on paper, justify O(n); O(1), and expose: Return second middle in even length.
Switching paths cancels different prefix lengths. Mastery: reconstruct unaided, demonstrate node/link invariant on paper, justify O(n+m); O(1), and expose: Shared identities, not equal payloads.
Fixed n-edge gap locates target predecessor. Mastery: reconstruct unaided, demonstrate node/link invariant on paper, justify O(n); O(1), and expose: Head removal and invalid gap.

Carry is the sole state between digit columns. Mastery: reconstruct unaided, demonstrate node/link invariant on paper, justify O(max(n,m)); O(max(n,m)) output, and expose: Final carry and reverse digits.
Meeting is not entry; reset phase solves entrance. Mastery: reconstruct unaided, demonstrate node/link invariant on paper, justify O(n); O(1), and expose: Collision differs from entry.
Extract nodes within a validated interval. Mastery: reconstruct unaided, demonstrate node/link invariant on paper, justify O(n); O(1), and expose: Inclusive positions and new head.
Detach and append to stable partitions. Mastery: reconstruct unaided, demonstrate node/link invariant on paper, justify O(n); O(1), and expose: Terminate tails to avoid cycles.
Position parity is not payload parity. Mastery: reconstruct unaided, demonstrate node/link invariant on paper, justify O(n); O(1), and expose: Odd/even position, not value.
Mirrors align after reversing second half; restore links. Mastery: reconstruct unaided, demonstrate node/link invariant on paper, justify O(n); O(1), and expose: Restore even on mismatch.
Weave disjoint halves after reversal. Mastery: reconstruct unaided, demonstrate node/link invariant on paper, justify O(n); O(1), and expose: Detach halves first.
Normalize rotation before creating temporary cycle. Mastery: reconstruct unaided, demonstrate node/link invariant on paper, justify O(n); O(1), and expose: k%=n; always break temporary cycle.
A duplicated run must disappear completely. Mastery: reconstruct unaided, demonstrate node/link invariant on paper, justify O(n); O(1), and expose: Remove all repeated values, not only extra copies.

Clone references must point at clones, never originals. Mastery: reconstruct unaided, demonstrate node/link invariant on paper, justify O(n); O(1) auxiliary + O(n) output interleaved, and expose: Restore original and clone random references.

Doubling sorted run width removes recursive frames. Mastery: reconstruct unaided, demonstrate node/link invariant on paper, justify O(n log n); O(1) auxiliary bottom-up, and expose: Top-down recursion costs O(log n) stack.

One front per input suffices to expose global minimum. Mastery: reconstruct unaided, demonstrate node/link invariant on paper, justify O(k+N log(k+1)); O(k), and expose: Tie-break nodes with a counter.
Lookahead preserves incomplete final groups. Mastery: reconstruct unaided, demonstrate node/link invariant on paper, justify O(n); O(1), and expose: Leave incomplete final group intact.

Map and DLL must contain exactly the same nodes. Mastery: reconstruct unaided, demonstrate node/link invariant on paper, justify O(1) expected amortized get/put; O(capacity), and expose: Zero capacity, updates, and accesses change recency.
